configuration.offlinesqlquery: /*CTEStart*/WITH __QuickFind__ as (select [businessprocessflowinstanceid] from (/*QuickFindStart*/ SELECT "translationprocess0".[businessprocessflowinstanceid] AS [businessprocessflowinstanceid] FROM [TranslationProcess] AS "translationprocess0"   where ("translationprocess0".[name] like {0}) OR ("translationprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!name] like {0}) OR ("translationprocess0".[activestageid!name] like {0}) LIMIT 10001/*QuickFindEnd*/) as [__QuickFindInternal__])/*CTEEnd*//*SelectStart*/select  "translationprocess0".[businessprocessflowinstanceid] as "businessprocessflowinstanceid" , "translationprocess0".[name] as "name" , "translationprocess0".[createdon] as "createdon" , "translationprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!id] as "knowledgearticleid!id" , "translationprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!logicalname] as "knowledgearticleid!logicalname" , "translationprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!name] as "knowledgearticleid!name" , "translationprocess0".[activestageid!id] as "activestageid!id" , "translationprocess0".[activestageid!logicalname] as "activestageid!logicalname" , "translationprocess0".[activestageid!name] as "activestageid!name" , "translationprocess0".[statecode] as "statecode" , "translationprocess0".[statuscode] as "statuscode" , "translationprocess0".[processid!id] as "processid!id" , "translationprocess0".[processid!logicalname] as "processid!logicalname" , "translationprocess0".[processid!name] as "processid!name"/*SelectEnd*/  /*FromStart*/from  TranslationProcess as "translationprocess0"/*FromEnd*/  /*WhereStart*/where  [translationprocess0].[businessprocessflowinstanceid] in (select [businessprocessflowinstanceid] from [__QuickFind__]) and (("translationprocess0".[statecode] = 0))/*WhereEnd*/  /*OrderByStart*/order by  "translationprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!id] asc/*OrderByEnd*/
